context: Asuka and Riku discuss diverse ecosystems.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science lecture; abstract vocabulary (総合/一体/さまざま/多数/有効) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 森には、さまざまな生き物がいます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 多数の生き物が、関わるんですか?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、多数の命が一体で生きています。
lines.en: Yes, many lives live as one whole.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それを、どう調べるんですか?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さまざまな情報を、総合して調べます。
lines.en: We integrate various information to study it.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 森を守るのに、有効な方法は?
lines.en: What's an effective way to protect the forest?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 総合的な保護が、最も有効です。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 森が一体だって、よく分かりました。
lines.en: I understand the forest is one whole.
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm realization throughout
